# Setup

```{r}

# Core minfi and microarray infrastructure
library(minfi)
library(wateRmelon)  # Required for bead count extraction from IDATs
library(DMRcate)     # For epicv2Remap() replicate handling
library(limma)
library(sva)
library(BiocParallel)
library(GenomicRanges)

# Manifest and Annotation Packages
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICmanifest)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38)

# Visualization & Data Wrangling
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(RSpectra)
library(Rtsne)
library(BiocParallel)

library(InfiniumPurify)
library(EpiDISH)
library(EpiSCORE)

register(MulticoreParam(workers = 8), default=TRUE)
Sys.setenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS" = 8)
Sys.setenv("OMP_THREAD_LIMIT" = 8)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# USER CONFIGURATION: Set your file and folder paths here
# ==============================================================================

PATH_METADATA <- "./data/SS_Appendix.csv"

# Path to directory containing raw EPICv1 (EPIC) .idat files
DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V1 <- "./data/EPICv1"

# Path to directory containing raw EPICv2 .idat files
DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V2 <- "./data/EPICv2"

# Quality Control Cutoffs
DETP_CUTOFF          <- 0.01  # Detection p-value failure threshold
SAMPLE_FAIL_RATE     <- 0.10  # Drop sample if > 10% of probes fail detP
PROBE_FAIL_RATE      <- 0     # Drop probe if > 0% of samples fail detP
MIN_BEAD_COUNT       <- 3     # Minimum required beads per probe
BEAD_FAIL_RATE       <- 0.05  # Drop probe if < 3 beads in > 5% of samples
SNP_MIN_MAF          <- 0.01  # Drop probes overlapping SNPs with MAF > 1%
# ==============================================================================

```

```{r}
########## Paths
meta <- read.csv(PATH_METADATA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(meta) <- meta$Sample_Nr

cat("Total samples registered:", nrow(meta), "\n")
table(Diagnosis = meta$Diagnosis, Array = meta$Array)

# Extract archival block year from Charité accession number (E/YYYY/...)
#meta$Block_Year <- as.numeric(substr(meta$E_Nr, 3, 6))

# Construct full Basename paths depending on platform
meta$Full_Basename <- ifelse(
  meta$Array == "EPIC",
  file.path(DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V1, meta$File_Name),
  file.path(DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V2, meta$File_Name)
)

# Verify IDAT file presence
idat_exists <- file.exists(paste0(meta$Full_Basename, "_Grn.idat")) | 
               file.exists(paste0(meta$Full_Basename, "_Grn.idat.gz"))

if (!all(idat_exists)) {
  stop("Missing IDAT files for samples: ", paste(meta$Sample_Nr[!idat_exists], collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("All IDAT pairs successfully verified on disk.")
}

meta$Diagnosis <- factor(meta$Diagnosis)
meta$Array <- factor(meta$Array, levels = c("EPICv2", "EPIC")) # EPICv2 reference
meta$Sex <- factor(meta$Sex)


```

# Load Data

```{r}
meta_v1 <- meta[meta$Array == "EPIC", ]
meta_v2 <- meta[meta$Array == "EPICv2", ]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. Process EPICv1
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Reading EPICv1 RGChannelSet (N = ", nrow(meta_v1), ")...")
rg_v1 <- read.metharray(meta_v1$Full_Basename, verbose = FALSE, force = TRUE, extended = TRUE)
sampleNames(rg_v1) <- meta_v1$Sample_Nr
annotation(rg_v1) <- c(array = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPIC", annotation = "ilm10b4.hg19")

# Detection p-values & Bead counts
detP_v1 <- detectionP(rg_v1)
beads_v1 <- beadcount(rg_v1)

# Sample-level QC filter
sample_fail_v1 <- colMeans(detP_v1 > DETP_CUTOFF) > SAMPLE_FAIL_RATE
if (any(sample_fail_v1)) {
  warning("Dropping poor-quality EPICv1 samples (> 5% detP failure): ", 
          paste(names(which(sample_fail_v1)), collapse = ", "))
  rg_v1 <- rg_v1[, !sample_fail_v1]
  meta_v1 <- meta_v1[!sample_fail_v1, ]
  detP_v1 <- detP_v1[, !sample_fail_v1]
  beads_v1 <- beads_v1[, !sample_fail_v1]
}

# Probe-level QC filter (detP + bead counts < 3)
probes_pass_detP_v1  <- rowMeans(detP_v1 > DETP_CUTOFF) <= PROBE_FAIL_RATE
probes_pass_beads_v1 <- rowMeans(is.na(beads_v1) | beads_v1 < MIN_BEAD_COUNT) <= BEAD_FAIL_RATE
valid_probes_v1      <- names(which(probes_pass_detP_v1 & probes_pass_beads_v1))

cat("EPICv1 probes passing detP and bead count QC:", length(valid_probes_v1), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. Process EPICv2
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Reading EPICv2 RGChannelSet (N = ", nrow(meta_v2), ")...")
rg_v2 <- read.metharray(meta_v2$Full_Basename, verbose = FALSE, force = TRUE, extended = TRUE)

sampleNames(rg_v2) <- meta_v2$Sample_Nr
annotation(rg_v2) <- c(array = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2", annotation = "20a1.hg38")

# Detection p-values & Bead counts
detP_v2 <- detectionP(rg_v2)
beads_v2 <- beadcount(rg_v2)

# Sample-level QC filter
sample_fail_v2 <- colMeans(detP_v2 > DETP_CUTOFF) > SAMPLE_FAIL_RATE
if (any(sample_fail_v2)) {
  warning("Dropping poor-quality EPICv2 samples (> 5% detP failure): ", 
          paste(names(which(sample_fail_v2)), collapse = ", "))
  rg_v2 <- rg_v2[, !sample_fail_v2]
  meta_v2 <- meta_v2[!sample_fail_v2, ]
  detP_v2 <- detP_v2[, !sample_fail_v2]
  beads_v2 <- beads_v2[, !sample_fail_v2]
}

# Probe-level QC filter
probes_pass_detP_v2  <- rowMeans(detP_v2 > DETP_CUTOFF) <= PROBE_FAIL_RATE
probes_pass_beads_v2 <- rowMeans(is.na(beads_v2) | beads_v2 < MIN_BEAD_COUNT) <= BEAD_FAIL_RATE
valid_probes_v2      <- names(which(probes_pass_detP_v2 & probes_pass_beads_v2))

cat("EPICv2 probes passing detP and bead count QC:", length(valid_probes_v2), "\n")

```

# Normalization & Filtering

```{r}
message("Running preprocessNoob on EPICv1...")
mset_v1 <- preprocessNoob(rg_v1, dyeMethod = "reference")
grset_v1 <- ratioConvert(mapToGenome(mset_v1), what = "both", keepCN = FALSE)

message("Running preprocessNoob on EPICv2...")
mset_v2 <- preprocessNoob(rg_v2, dyeMethod = "reference")
grset_v2 <- ratioConvert(mapToGenome(mset_v2), what = "both", keepCN = FALSE)

# Filter each platform by its own surviving detP/bead-count probes
grset_v1 <- grset_v1[rownames(grset_v1) %in% valid_probes_v1, ]
grset_v2 <- grset_v2[rownames(grset_v2) %in% valid_probes_v2, ]

# Extract normalized beta matrices
betas_v1 <- getBeta(grset_v1)

# Remapping and collapsing EPICv2
## 1. Pull the official EPICv2 annotation table
anno_v2 <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38)
anno_v2_df <- as.data.frame(anno_v2)

## 2. Extract base 10-character CpG IDs (stripping _BC11, _TC21, etc.)
anno_v2_df$Base_CpG <- substr(rownames(anno_v2_df), 1, 10)

## 3. Extract the raw beta matrix from the EPICv2 GenomicRatioSet
betas_v2_raw <- getBeta(grset_v2)

group_factor <- factor(substr(rownames(betas_v2_raw), 1, 10))

# Fast matrix row collapsing: aggregate mean per CpG
betas_v2 <- rowsum(betas_v2_raw, group_factor, na.rm = TRUE) / 
  rowsum((!is.na(betas_v2_raw)) * 1, group_factor)

# Replace any 0/0 divisions with NA
betas_v2[is.nan(betas_v2)] <- NA

cat("EPICv1 normalized dimensions:", dim(betas_v1), "\n")
cat("EPICv2 remapped dimensions:", dim(betas_v2), "\n")
```

# QC

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Manifest Extraction & Base CpG Identifier Harmonization
# ==============================================================================
message("Extracting annotation manifests for EPICv1 (hg19) and EPICv2 (hg38)...")
anno_v1 <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
anno_v2 <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38)

# Convert row annotations to base 10-character CpG IDs (cgXXXXXXXX)
v1_base_ids <- rownames(anno_v1)
v2_base_ids <- substr(rownames(anno_v2), 1, 10)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Symmetrical SNP Masking (SBE & Target CpG Dinucleotide, MAF > 1%)
# ==============================================================================
message("Filtering SNPs at SBE and target CpG sites (MAF > ", SNP_MIN_MAF, ")...")

# EPICv1: extract probes with common SNPs at SBE or CpG site
grset_v1_nosnp <- dropLociWithSnps(grset_v1, snps = c("CpG", "SBE"), maf = SNP_MIN_MAF)
cpgs_snp_v1    <- setdiff(rownames(grset_v1), rownames(grset_v1_nosnp))

# EPICv2: apply identical SBE and CpG site variant criteria
snp_v2_mask <- (!is.na(anno_v2$CpG_rs) & anno_v2$CpG_maf > SNP_MIN_MAF) |
               (!is.na(anno_v2$SBE_rs) & anno_v2$SBE_maf > SNP_MIN_MAF)
cpgs_snp_v2 <- unique(v2_base_ids[snp_v2_mask])

cpgs_snp_all <- unique(c(cpgs_snp_v1, cpgs_snp_v2))
cat("Total probes flagged for SBE/CpG polymorphisms:", length(cpgs_snp_all), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Multi-Hit & Cross-Reactive Filtering
# ==============================================================================
message("Identifying cross-reactive, multi-hit, and off-target probes...")

# DMRcate filtering: nearby SNPs with MAF > 1% and known cross-reactive probes
# Run separately with each platform's probe IDs.

# EPICv1
dummy_mat_v1 <- matrix(
  0.5,
  nrow = nrow(anno_v1),
  ncol = 2,
  dimnames = list(rownames(anno_v1), c("sample1", "sample2"))
)

filtered_mat_v1 <- DMRcate::rmSNPandCH(
  dummy_mat_v1,
  dist = 0,
  mafcut = 0.01,
  and = TRUE,
  rmcrosshyb = TRUE,
  rmXY = FALSE
)

probes_removed_dmr_v1 <- setdiff(
  rownames(dummy_mat_v1),
  rownames(filtered_mat_v1)
)
cpgs_dmr_v1 <- unique(substr(probes_removed_dmr_v1, 1, 10))


# EPICv2
dummy_mat_v2 <- matrix(
  0.5,
  nrow = nrow(anno_v2),
  ncol = 2,
  dimnames = list(rownames(anno_v2), c("sample1", "sample2"))
)

filtered_mat_v2 <- DMRcate::rmSNPandCH(
  dummy_mat_v2,
  dist = 0,
  mafcut = 0.01,
  and = TRUE,
  rmcrosshyb = TRUE,
  rmXY = FALSE
)

probes_removed_dmr_v2 <- setdiff(
  rownames(dummy_mat_v2),
  rownames(filtered_mat_v2)
)
cpgs_dmr_v2 <- unique(substr(probes_removed_dmr_v2, 1, 10))


# Combine DMRcate exclusions across platforms
cpgs_multihit_all <- unique(c(cpgs_dmr_v1, cpgs_dmr_v2))

cat("EPICv1 DMRcate-excluded CpGs:", length(cpgs_dmr_v1), "\n")
cat("EPICv2 DMRcate-excluded CpGs:", length(cpgs_dmr_v2), "\n")
cat("Total unique DMRcate-excluded CpGs:", length(cpgs_multihit_all), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Identify ~1,300 Type I <-> Type II Chemistry & Channel-Switched Probes
# ==============================================================================
message("Identifying probes with chemistry or color channel switches between v1 and v2...")
shared_manifest_cpgs <- intersect(v1_base_ids, v2_base_ids)

idx_v1 <- match(shared_manifest_cpgs, v1_base_ids)
idx_v2 <- match(shared_manifest_cpgs, v2_base_ids)

type_switched  <- anno_v1$Type[idx_v1] != anno_v2$Type[idx_v2]
color_switched <- (anno_v1$Type[idx_v1] == "I") & (anno_v1$Color[idx_v1] != anno_v2$Color[idx_v2])

switched_chemistry_cpgs <- shared_manifest_cpgs[type_switched | color_switched]
cat("Chemistry/channel-switched probes identified to drop:", length(switched_chemistry_cpgs), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Sex Chromosome & Non-CpG (ch.* / rs.*) Exclusion Sets
# ==============================================================================
sex_cpgs_v1 <- rownames(anno_v1)[anno_v1$chr %in% c("chrX", "chrY")]
sex_cpgs_v2 <- unique(v2_base_ids[anno_v2$chr %in% c("chrX", "chrY")])
sex_cpgs_all <- unique(c(sex_cpgs_v1, sex_cpgs_v2))

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Intersect Valid Probes, Strip Exclusion Sets & Enforce Non-CpG Filter
# ==============================================================================
shared_passing_qc <- intersect(rownames(betas_v1), rownames(betas_v2))

exclusion_set <- unique(c(
  switched_chemistry_cpgs,
  sex_cpgs_all,
  cpgs_multihit_all,
  cpgs_snp_all
))

# Strip all exclusion categories
probes_filtered <- setdiff(shared_passing_qc, exclusion_set)

# Enforce Non-CpG filter: retain ONLY true CpG dinucleotide probes (cg*)
final_cpgs <- probes_filtered[grepl("^cg", probes_filtered)]

cat("----------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Final high-confidence shared CpG count for analysis:", length(final_cpgs), "\n")
cat("----------------------------------------------------------------------\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 7. Synchronize Metadata & Assemble Combined Expression Matrices
# ==============================================================================
meta_clean <- rbind(meta_v1, meta_v2)

# Merge beta matrices across the final validated CpG subset
combined_mat <- cbind(betas_v1[final_cpgs, ], betas_v2[final_cpgs, ])

# Map column names reliably (handles Sample_Nr vs File_Name alignments)
if (!all(meta_clean$Sample_Nr %in% colnames(combined_mat))) {
  if (all(meta_clean$File_Name %in% colnames(combined_mat))) {
    col_order <- match(colnames(combined_mat), meta_clean$File_Name)
    colnames(combined_mat) <- meta_clean$Sample_Nr[col_order]
  }
}

surviving_samples <- intersect(meta_clean$Sample_Nr, colnames(combined_mat))
meta_clean <- meta_clean[match(surviving_samples, meta_clean$Sample_Nr), ]
betas_combined <- combined_mat[, meta_clean$Sample_Nr]

# Convert to logit M-values (clipping extremes for numerical stability)
betas_clipped <- pmin(pmax(betas_combined, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
mvals_combined <- log2(betas_clipped / (1 - betas_clipped))

cat("Combined matrix dimensions (CpGs x Samples):", dim(mvals_combined), "\n")
cat("Metadata rows matching combined matrix:     ", nrow(meta_clean), "\n")
```

# Batch Effect Correction

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 6. Batch effect removal of Array effects
# ==============================================================================

design_bio <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Diagnosis, data = meta_clean)

# Subtract platform effect (EPICv1 relative to EPICv2)
mvals_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(
  mvals_combined,
  batch = meta_clean$Array,
  covariates = model.matrix(~ Sex, data = meta_clean)[, -1, drop = FALSE],
  design = design_bio
)

# Convert corrected M-values back to Betas for clustering/heatmaps
betas_corrected <- 2^mvals_corrected / (1 + 2^mvals_corrected)
colnames(betas_corrected) <- meta_clean$File_Name

write.csv(betas_corrected, "./results/betas_corrected.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# DMP

```{r}
library(limma)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Clean factors & build clean design matrix (Array + Sex ONLY)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
meta_clean$Diagnosis <- droplevels(factor(meta_clean$Diagnosis))
meta_clean$Array     <- droplevels(factor(meta_clean$Array, levels = c("EPICv2", "EPIC")))
meta_clean$Sex       <- droplevels(factor(meta_clean$Sex))

# Model adjusting for Array and Sex (Sentrix_Row omitted to prevent confounding with normal_appendix)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Diagnosis + Array + Sex, data = meta_clean)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
colnames(design) <- gsub("^Diagnosis", "", colnames(design))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit weighted linear model on M-values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Estimating sample array weights and fitting linear model...")
aw  <- arrayWeights(mvals_combined, design = design)
fit <- lmFit(mvals_combined, design = design, weights = aw)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Setup all pairwise contrasts
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
diag_levels <- levels(meta_clean$Diagnosis)
pairs <- combn(diag_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)

contrast_strings <- sapply(pairs, function(p) paste0(p[1], " - ", p[2]))
names(contrast_strings) <- sapply(pairs, function(p) paste0(p[1], "_vs_", p[2]))

cont_mat <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_strings, levels = colnames(design))
fit_contrasts <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, cont_mat), robust = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Pre-calculate true group mean Betas from betas_corrected
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# betas_corrected has already had Array and Sex effects cleanly subtracted!
message("Pre-calculating group mean Betas from batch-corrected matrix...")
mean_betas_by_group <- sapply(diag_levels, function(d) {
  # Match samples by File_Name or Sample_Nr
  s_ids <- meta_clean$File_Name[meta_clean$Diagnosis == d]
  if (!all(s_ids %in% colnames(betas_corrected))) {
    s_ids <- meta_clean$File_Name[meta_clean$Diagnosis == d]
  }
  valid_s <- intersect(s_ids, colnames(betas_corrected))
  rowMeans(betas_corrected[, valid_s, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Extract DMPs with Standard BH and True Delta Beta
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DELTA_BETA_CUTOFF <- 0.30
ADJ_PVAL_CUTOFF   <- 0.01

dmps_by_contrast <- lapply(seq_along(pairs), function(i) {
  p  <- pairs[[i]]
  g1 <- p[1]
  g2 <- p[2]
  cname <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)
  
  # A. Extract topTable statistics directly from limma
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit_contrasts, coef = i, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  
  # B. Assign group mean Betas and true Delta Beta from betas_corrected
  m_g1 <- mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g1]
  m_g2 <- mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g2]
  dB   <- m_g1 - m_g2
  
  tt$mean_Beta_1    <- m_g1
  tt$mean_Beta_2    <- m_g2
  tt$deltaBeta      <- dB
  tt$abs_deltaBeta  <- abs(dB)
  
  colnames(tt)[colnames(tt) == "mean_Beta_1"] <- paste0("mean_", g1)
  colnames(tt)[colnames(tt) == "mean_Beta_2"] <- paste0("mean_", g2)
  
  # Diagnostic inflation check (informational only; do not let bacon crush cancer signal)
  lambda_gc <- median(tt$t^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 0.455
  message(sprintf("[%s] lambda_GC = %.2f", cname, ifelse(is.na(lambda_gc), 0, lambda_gc)))
  
  # C. Filter on adj.P.Val < 0.01 AND |deltaBeta| >= 0.30
  sig <- subset(tt, adj.P.Val < ADJ_PVAL_CUTOFF & abs_deltaBeta >= DELTA_BETA_CUTOFF)
  sig[order(sig$adj.P.Val, -sig$abs_deltaBeta), ]
})
names(dmps_by_contrast) <- names(contrast_strings)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Summary Table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dmp_summary <- data.frame(
  Contrast  = names(dmps_by_contrast),
  DMP_Count_0.30 = sapply(dmps_by_contrast, nrow)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save DMPs to Disk (2 CSV files per pairwise contrast)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
output_dir <- "./results/DMP_results"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
message(sprintf("Exporting DMP tables to: %s", normalizePath(output_dir)))

# Optional: Map probe annotations if anno_v1 exists in memory
has_anno <- exists("anno_v1")

for (i in seq_along(pairs)) {
  p  <- pairs[[i]]
  g1 <- p[1]
  g2 <- p[2]
  cname <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)
  
  # A. Extract full statistics from limma
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit_contrasts, coef = i, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  
  # B. Add group means and deltaBeta calculated from betas_corrected
  m_g1 <- mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g1]
  m_g2 <- mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g2]
  dB   <- m_g1 - m_g2
  
  tt$CpG            <- rownames(tt)
  tt$mean_Beta_1    <- m_g1
  tt$mean_Beta_2    <- m_g2
  tt$deltaBeta      <- dB
  tt$abs_deltaBeta  <- abs(dB)
  
  colnames(tt)[colnames(tt) == "mean_Beta_1"] <- paste0("mean_", g1)
  colnames(tt)[colnames(tt) == "mean_Beta_2"] <- paste0("mean_", g2)
  
  # C. Append biological gene annotation if available
  if (has_anno) {
    cpg_idx <- match(tt$CpG, rownames(anno_v1))
    tt$Gene_Symbol <- anno_v1$UCSC_RefGene_Name[cpg_idx]
    tt$Gene_Group  <- anno_v1$UCSC_RefGene_Group[cpg_idx]
    tt$chr         <- anno_v1$chr[cpg_idx]
    tt$pos         <- anno_v1$pos[cpg_idx]
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # File 1: Filtered ONLY by adjusted p-value (adj.P.Val < 0.01)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  dmps_pval_only <- subset(tt, adj.P.Val < ADJ_PVAL_CUTOFF)
  dmps_pval_only <- dmps_pval_only[order(dmps_pval_only$adj.P.Val, -dmps_pval_only$abs_deltaBeta), ]
  
  file_pval_only <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("DMP_", cname, "_adjP0.01_allDeltaBeta.csv"))
  write.csv(dmps_pval_only, file = file_pval_only, row.names = FALSE)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # File 2: Filtered by BOTH adj.P.Val < 0.01 AND abs(deltaBeta) >= 0.30
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  dmps_with_cutoff <- subset(dmps_pval_only, abs_deltaBeta >= DELTA_BETA_CUTOFF)
  dmps_with_cutoff <- dmps_with_cutoff[order(dmps_with_cutoff$adj.P.Val, -dmps_with_cutoff$abs_deltaBeta), ]
  
  file_with_cutoff <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("DMP_", cname, "_adjP0.01_deltaBeta0.30.csv"))
  write.csv(dmps_with_cutoff, file = file_with_cutoff, row.names = FALSE)
  
  message(sprintf("[%s] Saved: %d DMPs (p-val only) | %d DMPs (with 0.30 cutoff)", 
                  cname, nrow(dmps_pval_only), nrow(dmps_with_cutoff)))
}

message("All DMP files successfully written to disk.")
print(dmp_summary)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Multi-Threshold DMP Evaluation Across All Pairwise Contrasts
# ==============================================================================
message("Evaluating DMP counts across |deltaBeta| thresholds (0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30)...")

threshold_matrix_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(pairs), function(i) {
  p  <- pairs[[i]]
  g1 <- p[1]
  g2 <- p[2]
  cname <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)
  
  # 1. Extract full topTable statistics from limma
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit_contrasts, coef = i, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  
  # 2. Compute absolute deltaBeta from batch-corrected group means
  m_g1 <- mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g1]
  m_g2 <- mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g2]
  abs_dB <- abs(m_g1 - m_g2)
  
  # 3. Calculate lambda_GC for reference
  lambda_gc <- round(median(tt$t^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 0.455, 2)
  
  # 4. Filter significant probes at FDR < 0.01
  is_sig <- !is.na(tt$adj.P.Val) & tt$adj.P.Val < 0.01
  
  data.frame(
    Contrast          = cname,
    lambda_GC         = lambda_gc,
    FDR_0.01_Total    = sum(is_sig),

    DMP_dB_0.20       = sum(is_sig & abs_dB >= 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    DMP_dB_0.25       = sum(is_sig & abs_dB >= 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    DMP_dB_0.30       = sum(is_sig & abs_dB >= 0.30, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}))
```

```{r}
set.seed(122) # reference uses 122

# Values to try
k_values <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25)
perplexity_values <- c( 10, 12, 15, 20, 25)

plots <- list()

dir.create('./TSNE_plots', showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (k in k_values) {
  # SVD only needs to run once per k
  sv <- svds(all_betas.centr, k = k)
  scores <- sv$u %*% diag(sv$d)

  for (perp in perplexity_values) {
    set.seed(122) # same seed for every run, so results are comparable

    tsne_top_val <- Rtsne(scores, dims = 2, verbose = FALSE, pca = FALSE,
                          max_iter = 5000, theta = 0, perplexity = perp)

    tsne_top.data_val <- data.frame(
      X1 = tsne_top_val$Y[, 1],
      X2 = tsne_top_val$Y[, 2],
      Names = all_anno$Diagnosis,
      Type = as.factor(all_anno$Diagnosis)
    )

    p <- ggplot(tsne_top.data_val, aes(x = X1, y = X2, color = Type)) +
      geom_point(size = 3.5) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cols_type) +
      ggtitle(paste0("k = ", k, ", perplexity = ", perp)) +
      theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "white"),
            legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.y = element_blank())
    
    ggsave(paste0("./TSNE_plots/tsne_5000_k", k, "_perp", perp, ".png"), scale=2)
    write.csv(tsne_top.data_val, 
              file = paste0("./TSNE_plots/tsne_5000_k", k, "_perp", perp, "_coordinates.csv"), 
              row.names = FALSE)

    plots[[paste0("k", k, "_perp", perp)]] <- p
    
    print(p)
  }
}
```

# Heatmap

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(data.table)
library(circlize)

my_palette <- c(
  "#a6d3f1", "#468ccb", "#005492", "#d3e278", "#935423", "#009192",
  "#000000", "#f7921e", "#b589bd", "#aaaaaa", "#ee3524", "#8fd1c1", 
  "#941c52", "#e98fbc", "#919136", "#009046", "#ffd479", "#d6d6d5",
  "#f37c79", "#fcd6cf", "#c1c0c0", "#542d8c", "#ebebeb"
)

# Gives each label one color from the palette
auto_colors <- function(x, palette = my_palette, fixed = NULL) {
  labels <- sort(unique(as.character(x)))
  if (length(labels) > length(palette)) {
    warning("More labels than colors. Colors will repeat.")
  }
  cols <- setNames(rep(palette, length.out = length(labels)), labels)
  if (!is.null(fixed)) {
    keep <- intersect(names(fixed), labels)
    cols[keep] <- fixed[keep]
  }
  cols
}

# Makes one annotation heatmap from a column
anno_heatmap <- function(values, name, palette = my_palette,
                         fixed = NULL, width = unit(1, "cm")) {
  m <- as.matrix(values)
  colnames(m) <- name
  Heatmap(m, name = name, col = auto_colors(values, palette, fixed), width = width)
}
```

```{r}
library(methylGSA)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GO.db)
library(data.table)

gsa_dir <- "./results/methylGSA_results"
dir.create(gsa_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

tumours     <- c("LAMN", "HAMN", "MAC", "GCAC", "NET", "AC_NOS", "COAD")
comparisons <- paste0(tumours, "_vs_normal_appendix")

# limma results for all tested CpGs (input for methylGSA)
for (cname in comparisons) {
  i  <- match(cname, names(contrast_strings))
  g1 <- pairs[[i]][1]
  g2 <- pairs[[i]][2]
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit_contrasts, coef = i, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  tt$CpG       <- rownames(tt)
  tt$deltaBeta <- mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g1] - mean_betas_by_group[rownames(tt), g2]
  tt <- as.data.table(tt)
  fwrite(tt[, .(CpG, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B, deltaBeta)],
         file.path(gsa_dir, paste0("limma_allCpGs_", cname, ".csv.gz")))
}

# Background: all tested CpGs annotated to a gene (all gene regions)
anno <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
anno <- anno[nchar(rownames(anno)) == 10 & anno$UCSC_RefGene_Name != "", ]
first_of <- function(x) vapply(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE), `[`, 1, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
cpg_anno <- data.table(CpG   = rownames(anno),
                       Gene  = first_of(anno$UCSC_RefGene_Name),
                       Group = first_of(anno$UCSC_RefGene_Group))

all_groups <- c("TSS1500", "TSS200", "Body", "1stExon", "5'UTR", "3'UTR", "ExonBnd")
bg <- cpg_anno[Group %in% all_groups & CpG %in% rownames(fit_contrasts), .(CpG, Gene)]
FullAnnot <- prepareAnnot(as.data.frame(bg), geneidtype = "SYMBOL")

# GO gene sets (BP, MF, CC) restricted to background genes, 10-2000 genes
go_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = unique(bg$Gene),
                                columns = "GOALL", keytype = "SYMBOL")
go_map <- unique(as.data.table(go_map)[!is.na(GOALL), .(GO = GOALL, Gene = SYMBOL)])
gs <- split(go_map$Gene, go_map$GO)
gs <- gs[lengths(gs) >= 10 & lengths(gs) <= 2000]

go_terms <- AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, keys = unique(go_map$GO),
                                  columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY"), keytype = "GOID")
go_terms <- as.data.table(go_terms)[, .(ID = GOID, Description = TERM, Ontology = ONTOLOGY)]

cat("Background:", nrow(bg), "CpGs,", uniqueN(bg$Gene), "genes,", length(gs), "GO terms tested\n")

# methylglm
for (cname in comparisons) {
  tt <- fread(file.path(gsa_dir, paste0("limma_allCpGs_", cname, ".csv.gz")),
              select = c("CpG", "P.Value"))
  pval <- setNames(tt$P.Value, tt$CpG)
  pval <- pval[!is.na(pval)]
  pval[pval == 0] <- .Machine$double.xmin   # methylglm does not accept p = 0
  pval <- pval[names(pval) %in% bg$CpG]

  res <- methylglm(cpg.pval = pval, FullAnnot = FullAnnot, GS.list = gs,
                   GS.idtype = "SYMBOL", minsize = 10, maxsize = 2000,
                   parallel = TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 4))
  res <- as.data.table(res)
  res <- merge(go_terms, res, by = "ID", all.y = TRUE)
  setorder(res, pvalue)
  fwrite(res, file.path(gsa_dir, paste0("methylglm_GO_all_", cname, ".csv")))
}

# Top 10 significant GO terms (padj < 0.05) per comparison, ranked by p-value.
top10_terms <- function(d) {
  d <- d[padj < 0.05 & !is.na(Description)][order(pvalue)]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
  cand <- head(d, 100)
  m <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = cand$ID, columns = "SYMBOL", keytype = "GOALL")
  m <- unique(as.data.table(m)[!is.na(SYMBOL), .(GOALL, SYMBOL)])
  genes <- lapply(setNames(cand$ID, cand$ID), function(id) m[GOALL == id, SYMBOL])
  keep <- character(0)
  for (id in cand$ID) {
    redundant <- any(vapply(keep, function(k) {
      length(intersect(genes[[id]], genes[[k]])) / length(union(genes[[id]], genes[[k]])) >= 0.5
    }, logical(1)))
    if (!redundant) keep <- c(keep, id)
    if (length(keep) == 10) break
  }
  d[ID %in% keep]
}

top10 <- rbindlist(lapply(comparisons, function(cname) {
  d <- top10_terms(fread(file.path(gsa_dir, paste0("methylglm_GO_all_", cname, ".csv"))))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.table(comparison = cname, d[, .(ID, Description, Ontology, Size, pvalue, padj)])
}))
fwrite(top10, file.path(gsa_dir, "methylglm_GO_all_top10.csv"))

# Shared top-10 terms between entities
shared <- sapply(comparisons, function(a) sapply(comparisons, function(b)
  length(intersect(top10[comparison == a, Description], top10[comparison == b, Description]))))
dimnames(shared) <- list(tumours, tumours)
shared
write.csv(shared, file.path(gsa_dir, "methylglm_GO_all_top10_shared.csv"))
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# A. Preprocessing for index scoring (noob + BMIQ, per platform)
# ==============================================================================

process_platform <- function(m, array_name, anno_pkg, anno_string) {

  rg <- read.metharray(m$Full_Basename, verbose = FALSE, force = TRUE, extended = TRUE)
  sampleNames(rg) <- m$Sample_Nr
  annotation(rg) <- anno_string

  detP  <- detectionP(rg)
  beads <- beadcount(rg)

  # Sample-level QC
  bad <- colMeans(detP > DETP_CUTOFF) > SAMPLE_FAIL_RATE
  if (any(bad)) {
    message("Dropping samples: ", paste(names(which(bad)), collapse = ", "))
    rg <- rg[, !bad]; m <- m[!bad, ]; detP <- detP[, !bad]; beads <- beads[, !bad]
  }

  # Probe-level QC
  ok_detP  <- rowMeans(detP > DETP_CUTOFF) <= 0.05
  ok_beads <- rowMeans(is.na(beads) | beads < MIN_BEAD_COUNT) <= BEAD_FAIL_RATE
  valid <- names(which(ok_detP & ok_beads))

  mset  <- preprocessNoob(rg, dyeMethod = "reference")
  grset <- ratioConvert(mapToGenome(mset), what = "both", keepCN = FALSE)
  grset <- grset[rownames(grset) %in% valid, ]
  betas <- getBeta(grset)

  anno  <- as.data.frame(getAnnotation(anno_pkg))
  types <- setNames(anno$Type, rownames(anno))

  # Collapse EPICv2 replicate probes to their base CpG identifier
  if (array_name == "EPICv2") {
    g     <- factor(substr(rownames(betas), 1, 10))
    tvec  <- types[rownames(betas)]
    betas <- rowsum(betas, g, na.rm = TRUE) / rowsum((!is.na(betas)) * 1, g)
    betas[is.nan(betas)] <- NA
        types <- tapply(tvec, g, function(x) if (length(unique(x)) == 1) x[1] else NA)
  } else {
    types <- types[rownames(betas)]
  }

  # BMIQ type I/II correction, using each platform's own probe annotation
  design.v <- ifelse(types == "I", 1, 2)
  keep  <- !is.na(design.v)
  betas <- betas[keep, ]; design.v <- design.v[keep]

    bmiq_failed <- character(0)
  bmiq <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(betas)), function(j) {
    x <- betas[, j]; ok <- !is.na(x)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
    fit <- tryCatch(BMIQ(x[ok], design.v[ok], plots = FALSE)$nbeta,
                    error = function(e) {
                      bmiq_failed <<- c(bmiq_failed, colnames(betas)[j])
                      NULL
                    })
    if (!is.null(fit)) out[ok] <- fit
    out
  }, numeric(nrow(betas)))
  dimnames(bmiq) <- dimnames(betas)

  cat(array_name, "- CpGs:", nrow(betas),
      "| BMIQ failures:", length(bmiq_failed), "of", ncol(betas), "\n")
  if (length(bmiq_failed)) print(bmiq_failed)

  list(betas = bmiq, meta = m)
}

scoring_v1 <- process_platform(
  meta[meta$Array == "EPIC", ], "EPICv1",
  IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19,
  c(array = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPIC", annotation = "ilm10b4.hg19"))

scoring_v2 <- process_platform(
  meta[meta$Array == "EPICv2", ], "EPICv2",
  IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38,
  c(array = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2", annotation = "20a1.hg38"))

shared_scoring <- intersect(rownames(scoring_v1$betas), rownames(scoring_v2$betas))
shared_scoring <- shared_scoring[grepl("^cg", shared_scoring)]

meta_scoring  <- rbind(scoring_v1$meta, scoring_v2$meta)
betas_scoring <- cbind(scoring_v1$betas[shared_scoring, ],
                       scoring_v2$betas[shared_scoring, ])
betas_scoring <- betas_scoring[, meta_scoring$Sample_Nr]

cat("Scoring matrix:", nrow(betas_scoring), "CpGs x",
    ncol(betas_scoring), "samples\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# B. mDNAsi and epiTOC2 in the appendiceal cohort
# ==============================================================================

mdnasi_weights <- read.csv(PATH_MDNASI_WEIGHTS, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
mdnasi_weights <- setNames(mdnasi_weights$weight, mdnasi_weights$probe)

# Score = sum(weight * beta) over signature CpGs complete in every sample
score_signature <- function(betas, w) {
  on_array <- intersect(names(w), rownames(betas))
  usable   <- on_array[rowSums(is.na(betas[on_array, , drop = FALSE])) == 0]
  cat("  Signature CpGs used:", length(usable), "of", length(w), "\n")
  setNames(as.numeric(t(w[usable]) %*% betas[usable, , drop = FALSE]),
           colnames(betas))
}

                                           meta_scoring$Sample_Nr)],
```

```{r}
}

cat("mDNAsi, appendiceal cohort + iPSC reference:\n")
mdnasi_combined <- score_signature(betas_combined, mdnasi_weights)

stemness_ref <- data.frame(
  Sample_Nr = colnames(betas_combined),
  mDNAsi    = mdnasi_combined,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stemness_ref$Diagnosis <- ifelse(
  stemness_ref$Sample_Nr %in% ipsc_ids, "iPSC",
  as.character(meta_scoring$Diagnosis[match(stemness_ref$Sample_Nr,
                                            meta_scoring$Sample_Nr)]))

write.csv(stemness_ref, "./results/mDNAsi_with_iPSC_reference.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Copy Number Analysis

```{r}
library(conumee2)
library(sesame)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)

DIR_CNV <- file.path(dirname(PATH_METADATA), "CNV")
dir.create(file.path(DIR_CNV, "plots", "individual"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cnv_groups <- c("LAMN", "HAMN", "MAC", "GCAC", "NET", "AC_NOS", "COAD")
cnv_labels <- c(LAMN = "LAMN", HAMN = "HAMN", MAC = "MAD", GCAC = "GCAD",
                NET = "NET", AC_NOS = "AD NOS", COAD = "COAD")

# sample sheet
ss_cnv <- read.csv(PATH_METADATA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ss_cnv$idat <- ifelse(ss_cnv$Array == "EPICv2",
                      file.path(DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V2, ss_cnv$File_Name),
                      file.path(DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V1, ss_cnv$File_Name))
cnv_controls <- ss_cnv[ss_cnv$Diagnosis == "normal_appendix", ]
cnv_queries <- ss_cnv[ss_cnv$Diagnosis %in% cnv_groups, ]

# annotation
data(exclude_regions)
data(detail_regions)
cnv_anno <- CNV.create_anno(bin_minsize = 50000, array_type = c("EPIC", "EPICv2"),
                            chrXY = FALSE, exclude_regions = exclude_regions,
                            detail_regions = detail_regions)

# total intensities (M + U); EPICv2 samples are converted to EPIC with mLiftOver
read_intensities <- function(samples) {
  res <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(samples))) {
    idat_dir <- if (samples$Array[i] == "EPICv2") DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V2 else DIR_IDATS_EPIC_V1
    idat_path <- file.path(idat_dir, samples$File_Name[i])
    sdf <- readIDATpair(idat_path)
    if (samples$Array[i] == "EPICv2") sdf <- mLiftOver(sdf, "EPIC")
    int <- totalIntensities(sdf)
    int <- int[intersect(names(int), names(cnv_anno@probes))]
    res[[samples$Sample_Nr[i]]] <- int[is.finite(int)]
  }
  res
}

ctrl_int <- read_intensities(cnv_controls)
query_int <- read_intensities(cnv_queries)

probes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(c(ctrl_int, query_int), names))
ctrl_mat <- sapply(ctrl_int, function(v) v[probes])
query_mat <- sapply(query_int, function(v) v[probes])
rownames(ctrl_mat) <- rownames(query_mat) <- probes

# conumee2 pipeline
cnv <- CNV.fit(CNV.load(query_mat), CNV.load(ctrl_mat), cnv_anno)
cnv <- CNV.bin(cnv)
cnv <- CNV.detail(cnv)
set.seed(1)
cnv <- CNV.segment(cnv)

cnv_samples <- colnames(query_mat)
cnv_diagnosis <- cnv_queries$Diagnosis[match(cnv_samples, cnv_queries$Sample_Nr)]
```

```{r}
# segment means corrected for the baseline shift of each sample
segs <- rbindlist(lapply(names(cnv@seg$summary), function(s) {
  d <- cnv@seg$summary[[s]]
  data.table(sample = s, chrom = as.character(d$chrom), start = d$loc.start,
             end = d$loc.end, seg_mean = d$seg.mean - cnv@bin$shift[[s]])
}))
segs[, diagnosis := cnv_diagnosis[match(sample, cnv_samples)]]
fwrite(segs, file.path(DIR_CNV, "segments_corrected.csv"))

# gene level: mean segment value per gene and sample, gain > 0.1, loss < -0.1
genes_gr <- GenomicFeatures::genes(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
genes_gr$symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, names(genes_gr), "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
genes_gr <- genes_gr[!is.na(genes_gr$symbol)]

ov <- findOverlaps(genes_gr, GRanges(segs$chrom, IRanges(segs$start, segs$end)))
gene_seg <- data.table(gene = queryHits(ov), sample = segs$sample[subjectHits(ov)],
                       diagnosis = segs$diagnosis[subjectHits(ov)],
                       seg_mean = segs$seg_mean[subjectHits(ov)])
gene_seg <- gene_seg[, .(value = mean(seg_mean)), by = .(gene, sample, diagnosis)]

gene_freq <- list()
for (g in cnv_groups) {
  n <- sum(cnv_diagnosis == g)
  calls <- gene_seg[diagnosis == g, .(gain = sum(value > 0.1), loss = sum(value < -0.1)), by = gene]
  res <- data.table(gene_id = names(genes_gr), symbol = genes_gr$symbol,
                    chromosome = as.character(seqnames(genes_gr)),
                    start = start(genes_gr), end = end(genes_gr), total_samples = n,
                    samples_with_gain = 0, samples_with_loss = 0)
  res[calls$gene, `:=`(samples_with_gain = calls$gain, samples_with_loss = calls$loss)]
  res[, gain_proportion := samples_with_gain / n]
  res[, loss_proportion := samples_with_loss / n]
  res[, cnv_proportion := (samples_with_gain + samples_with_loss) / n]
  res <- res[order(-cnv_proportion)]
  fwrite(res, file.path(DIR_CNV, paste0("gene_cnv_summary_", g, ".csv")))
  gene_freq[[g]] <- res[, diagnosis := g]
}
gene_freq <- rbindlist(gene_freq)

chroms <- paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y"))
gene_freq <- gene_freq[chromosome %in% chroms]
gene_freq[, chromosome := factor(chromosome, levels = chroms)]
gene_freq <- gene_freq[order(chromosome)]
```

```{r}
    geom_segment(aes(x = pos, xend = pos, y = 0, yend = gain_proportion),
                 colour = "tomato3", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = pos, xend = pos, y = 0, yend = -loss_proportion),
                 colour = "royalblue3", linewidth = 0.25) +

    scale_x_continuous(breaks = offset + chr_len / 2, labels = sub("chr", "", chroms),
                       expand = c(0.005, 0.005)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.25),
                       labels = function(v) paste0(abs(v) * 100, "%")) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Frequency in cohort") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8))
}

freq_plots <- list()
for (g in cnv_groups) {
  freq_plots[[g]] <- plot_freq(gene_freq[diagnosis == g],
                               paste0(cnv_labels[g], " (n = ", sum(cnv_diagnosis == g), ")"))

         width = 14, height = 4)
}
ggsave(file.path(DIR_CNV, "plots", "CNV_frequency_all.pdf"), wrap_plots(freq_plots, ncol = 1),
       width = 14, height = 3 * length(cnv_groups))
```

# Distance Measurements 

```{r}
library(limma)
library(matrixStats)
library(ranger)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(ggplot2)

# ==============================================================================
# 0. Output Directory & Configuration
# ==============================================================================
out_dir <- "./results/similarity_selected_methods"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

SIM_SEED   <- 42
N_THREADS  <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
N_FEAT_RF  <- 20000  # Top 20,000 CpGs by beta SD for Random Forest
PCA_K      <- 15     # First 15 PCs for PCA Energy Distance
N_PERM     <- 9999   # Label permutations for PCA Energy Distance

# Prepare inputs (all finite preprocessed CpGs)
sim_m <- mvals_corrected
colnames(sim_m) <- meta_clean$File_Name
sim_m <- sim_m[rowSums(!is.finite(sim_m)) == 0, ]
sim_b <- 2^sim_m / (1 + 2^sim_m)

sim_y          <- droplevels(factor(meta_clean$Diagnosis))
sim_levels     <- levels(sim_y)
sim_n          <- table(sim_y)
sim_pairs      <- combn(sim_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
sim_pair_names <- sapply(sim_pairs, paste, collapse = "_vs_")

# Helper functions: Pair vector <-> symmetric K x K matrix
sim_vec_to_mat <- function(v) {
  M <- matrix(0, length(sim_levels), length(sim_levels),
              dimnames = list(sim_levels, sim_levels))
  for (i in seq_along(sim_pairs)) {
    M[sim_pairs[[i]][1], sim_pairs[[i]][2]] <-
      M[sim_pairs[[i]][2], sim_pairs[[i]][1]] <- v[i]
  }
  M
}

sim_mat_to_vec <- function(M) {
  sapply(sim_pairs, function(p) M[p[1], p[2]])
}

sim_rank_mat <- function(M) {
  r <- rank(sim_mat_to_vec(M))
  R <- sim_vec_to_mat((r - 1) / (length(r) - 1))
  diag(R) <- NA
  R
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Reference DMP Counts (adj.P.Val < 0.01 & |deltaBeta| >= 0.30)
# ==============================================================================
sim_dmp_lookup <- if (exists("dmps_by_contrast")) {
  sapply(dmps_by_contrast, nrow)
} else {
  dmp_path <- if (file.exists("./results/DMP_results/DMP_summary.csv")) {
    "./results/DMP_results/DMP_summary.csv"
  } else {
    "./DMP_results/DMP_summary.csv"
  }
  s <- read.csv(dmp_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  setNames(s$DMP_dB_0.30, s$Contrast)
}

sim_dmp <- sapply(sim_pairs, function(p) {
  v <- sim_dmp_lookup[c(paste(p, collapse = "_vs_"),
                        paste(rev(p), collapse = "_vs_"))]
  v[!is.na(v)][1]
})
stopifnot(!anyNA(sim_dmp))
dmp_mat <- sim_vec_to_mat(sim_dmp)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Contrast Centroid Distance on All CpGs (limma_centroid)
# ==============================================================================
sim_meta <- data.frame(
  Diagnosis = sim_y,
  Array     = droplevels(factor(meta_clean$Array, levels = c("EPICv2", "EPIC"))),
  Sex       = droplevels(factor(meta_clean$Sex))
)
sim_design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Diagnosis + Array + Sex, data = sim_meta)
colnames(sim_design) <- gsub("^Diagnosis", "", make.names(colnames(sim_design)))

sim_aw   <- arrayWeights(sim_m, design = sim_design)
sim_fit  <- lmFit(sim_m, design = sim_design, weights = sim_aw)
sim_cont <- makeContrasts(
  contrasts = sapply(sim_pairs, paste, collapse = " - "),
  levels    = colnames(sim_design)
)
colnames(sim_cont) <- sim_pair_names
sim_fitc <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(sim_fit, sim_cont), robust = TRUE)

# Subtract empirical Bayes moderated sampling variance from squared contrasts
sim_se2            <- sim_fitc$stdev.unscaled^2 * sim_fitc$s2.post
limma_centroid_mat <- sim_vec_to_mat(
  sqrt(pmax(colMeans(sim_fitc$coefficients^2 - sim_se2), 0))
)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Out-of-Bag Random Forest Proximity on Top 20,000 CpGs (rf_proximity)
# ==============================================================================
sim_sd_order <- order(rowSds(sim_b), decreasing = TRUE)
top_cpgs_rf  <- rownames(sim_b)[head(sim_sd_order, min(N_FEAT_RF, nrow(sim_b)))]

sim_G <- model.matrix(~ 0 + sim_y)
x_rf  <- t(sim_b[top_cpgs_rf, ])

rf <- ranger(
  x            = x_rf,
  y            = sim_y,
  num.trees    = 5000,
  case.weights = as.vector(1 / sim_n[sim_y]),
  keep.inbag   = TRUE,
  num.threads  = N_THREADS,
  seed         = SIM_SEED
)

nodes <- predict(rf, x_rf, type = "terminalNodes", num.threads = N_THREADS)$predictions
oob   <- do.call(cbind, rf$inbag.counts) == 0
num   <- den <- matrix(0, nrow(x_rf), nrow(x_rf))

for (t in seq_len(ncol(nodes))) {
  both <- outer(oob[, t], oob[, t], "&")
  num  <- num + (both & outer(nodes[, t], nodes[, t], "=="))
  den  <- den + both
}
prox       <- num / pmax(den, 1)
diag(prox) <- 0

# Normalize between-class OOB proximity by within-class compactness
Pc <- crossprod(sim_G, prox %*% sim_G) / (outer(sim_n, sim_n) - diag(as.vector(sim_n)))
dimnames(Pc) <- list(sim_levels, sim_levels)
rf_proximity_mat <- 1 - Pc / sqrt(outer(diag(Pc), diag(Pc)))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. PCA Energy Distance on All CpGs (pca_energy) + 9,999 Permutations
# ==============================================================================
sim_X_all <- scale(t(sim_m), scale = FALSE)
sv        <- svd(sim_X_all, nu = PCA_K, nv = 0)
Z         <- sv$u %*% diag(sv$d[1:PCA_K])
Z         <- Z / sqrt(sum(colVars(Z)))
sim_D_primary <- as.matrix(dist(Z))

sim_energy_pair <- function(D, i1, i2) {
  n1 <- length(i1)
  n2 <- length(i2)
  2 * mean(D[i1, i2]) -
    sum(D[i1, i1]) / (n1 * (n1 - 1)) -
    sum(D[i2, i2]) / (n2 * (n2 - 1))
}

sim_energy_mat <- function(D) {
  sim_vec_to_mat(sapply(sim_pairs, function(p) {
    sim_energy_pair(D, which(sim_y == p[1]), which(sim_y == p[2]))
  }))
}

pca_energy_mat <- sim_energy_mat(sim_D_primary)

set.seed(SIM_SEED)
sim_energy_p <- sapply(sim_pairs, function(p) {
  idx <- which(sim_y %in% p)
  n1  <- sum(sim_y == p[1])
  D   <- sim_D_primary[idx, idx]
  obs <- sim_energy_pair(D, which(sim_y[idx] == p[1]), which(sim_y[idx] == p[2]))
  null <- replicate(N_PERM, {
    s <- sample(length(idx))
    sim_energy_pair(D, s[1:n1], s[-(1:n1)])
  })
  (1 + sum(null >= obs)) / (N_PERM + 1)
})
sim_energy_padj <- setNames(p.adjust(sim_energy_p, "BH"), sim_pair_names)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Export Distance Matrices & Pairwise Summary Table
# ==============================================================================
sim_all_mats <- list(
  DMPs_dB0.30    = dmp_mat,
  limma_centroid = limma_centroid_mat,
  rf_proximity   = rf_proximity_mat,
  pca_energy     = pca_energy_mat
)
sim_mats <- sim_all_mats[-1]

for (m in names(sim_all_mats)) {
  write.csv(
    sim_all_mats[[m]],
    file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("heatmap_matrix_", m, ".csv")),
    row.names = TRUE
  )
}

sim_table <- data.frame(
  Contrast    = sim_pair_names,
  DMPs_dB0.30 = sim_dmp,
  sapply(sim_mats, sim_mat_to_vec),
  energy_padj = sim_energy_padj[sim_pair_names],
  check.names = FALSE
)
sim_table <- sim_table[order(sim_table$DMPs_dB0.30), ]
write.csv(sim_table, file.path(out_dir, "pair_distance_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Comparative Heatmap Panel & Rank-Agreement Plots
# ==============================================================================
sim_ord      <- hclust(as.dist(log1p(sim_all_mats$DMPs_dB0.30)), method = "average")$order
sim_rank_col <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"))

sim_ht <- NULL
for (m in names(sim_all_mats)) {
  M   <- sim_all_mats[[m]][sim_ord, sim_ord]
  lab <- if (m == "DMPs_dB0.30") {
    formatC(M, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
  } else {
    formatC(M, format = "g", digits = 2)
  }
  sim_ht <- sim_ht + Heatmap(
    sim_rank_mat(sim_all_mats[[m]])[sim_ord, sim_ord],
    name                 = paste0("rank_", m),
    col                  = sim_rank_col,
    na_col               = "grey90",
    column_title         = m,
    cluster_rows         = FALSE,
    cluster_columns      = FALSE,
    show_heatmap_legend  = (m == "DMPs_dB0.30"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title  = "within-method\nrank",
      at     = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("similar", "different")
    ),
    row_names_side       = "left",
    row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    width                = unit(6.5, "cm"),
    height               = unit(6.5, "cm"),
    cell_fun             = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
      if (i != j) grid.text(lab[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5))
    }
  )
}

png(file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_panel.png"), width = 35, height = 11, units = "cm", res = 300)
draw(sim_ht)
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_panel.pdf"), width = 35 / 2.54, height = 11 / 2.54)
draw(sim_ht)
dev.off()

# Spearman rank correlation & rank-agreement plot vs DMP count
sim_rho <- sapply(names(sim_mats), function(m) {
  cor(sim_table[[m]], sim_table$DMPs_dB0.30, method = "spearman")
})

sim_rank_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sim_mats), function(m) {
  data.frame(
    method      = sprintf("%s (rho %.2f)", m, sim_rho[[m]]),
    Contrast    = sim_table$Contrast,
    DMP_rank    = rank(sim_table$DMPs_dB0.30),
    method_rank = rank(sim_table[[m]])
  )
}))
write.csv(sim_rank_df, file.path(out_dir, "diagnosis_similarity_rank_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_rank <- ggplot(sim_rank_df, aes(x = DMP_rank, y = method_rank)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, colour = "#2b5c8f") +
  geom_text(
    data  = subset(sim_rank_df, abs(DMP_rank - method_rank) >= 6),
    aes(label = Contrast),
    size  = 2.5,
    vjust = -0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "DMP rank (1 = most similar)",
    y = "Method rank"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "diagnosis_similarity.png"), p_rank, width = 12, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "diagnosis_similarity.pdf"), p_rank, width = 12, height = 4.2)
```
